WITH id_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
), shares AS (
    SELECT ID,
           record_count,
           1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM id_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT record_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the arithmetic mean across IDs with at least one Examination record; IDs with no records are not counted.
